actorName.title: Actor name
actorName.description: Requested name of the generated Actor. If one of your earlier successful runs of this Actor used the same name, this run is treated as a revision of that Actor: describe only the change in Requirements.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Describe what the generated Actor should do. For a revision (same Actor name as an earlier run), describe only the change you want, or the problem to fix.

language.title: Preferred language/runtime
language.description: Optional implementation preference, e.g. JavaScript, TypeScript, Python.

notes.title: Additional notes
notes.description: Optional additional information for the generator.

errorLog.sectionCaption: Report a problem with an Actor you received
errorLog.sectionDescription: If an Actor generated for you earlier fails, keep the same Actor name above, describe the problem in Requirements, and attach the evidence here. The fix is delivered as a new version. Please remove secrets such as tokens, cookies or passwords before pasting.
errorLog.title: Error log
errorLog.description: The error message or the last part of the failed run's log. The failed run's status message is a good start.

failedRunInput.title: Input of the failed run
failedRunInput.description: The exact input you used when the Actor failed, so the problem can be reproduced. Copy it from the failed run's Input tab (JSON view).

failedRunId.title: Failed run ID
failedRunId.description: Optional reference to the failed run in your account (run ID or Console URL).
